items.title: Jon Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 17, 2003 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I mean of course they’re Hall of Famers so you can’t really use the age as a factor, you have to factor in that variable. But you have veterans and young players. ctx.x: Well we certainly have the universities to teach jazz. Maybe the mentor thing has been replaced by that, by all the programs.

Well it’s kind of like I use the analogy of a basketball team. If you have a veteran team, and now this is before they’ve even played a game, but like the Los Angeles Lakers, they’re champions because they have veterans and young players. Now they have a 40- year-old, Malone, they’ve got 35-year-old Payton, a 30-year-old Shaquille O’Neall, 25- year-old Kobe Bryant.
